set.b:
A masterpiece. The characters, the backgrounds, the backstories, the connections, and the character development were all really intense, very close, and very affectionate. Compared to long series, this one, with only 12 to 13 episodes, did really good justice to a huge number of characters, especially the main ones. Violet is one of my very favorite characters. She impressed me from the very first episode, and I learned a lot from her and was motivated to be a better person. Her character development is beyond true. The way she loves the Major, her backstory, the way she learns about emotions, and the way she uses and takes advantage of being a Doll to understand humans and explore the emotions that different people have and different kinds of personalities is really, truly captivating. The animation is beyond this world compared to other anime from 2017 and can be compared to some of the greatest animation of that time. Even to this day the backgrounds are perfect. It was refreshing to watch an anime that is not just romantic and has a truly intentional plot, with no plot dumps and a good connection between the side cast as well. Gilbert, the Major, and his friend Hodgins are really well-written characters too. The war, and the way it connects the different characters and ties the events and episodes together, is really good. In the finale, the way they react to the letters, and the animation direction they went with to show how she wrote the Major her final letter, is truly emotional, well written, and very captivating. One of my favorite things about it is that it's really short but truly captivating and unforgettable. One of the best short series I've ever watched, and I learned a lot of things throughout the 13 episodes that I never thought about before. Looking forward to more anime like this.

Update, October 2026: I rewatched the entire show again with my family. My opinion of it became very good, even more positive, a lot more, and it increased my understanding of the character. She's one of the best characters I've ever seen. Simple, but more than enough for a human, and very realistic. As a character she also has some really good thoughtfulness.
